title: Uruguayan Garlic Bake
description: A flavorful Uruguayan-inspired casserole with a garlic kick. This bake is perfect for a casual dinner or lunch.
instructions: In a large skillet, sauté minced garlic until fragrant.
Add diced festive vegetables to the skillet and cook until tender.
In a separate bowl, whisk together gluten-free bake mix and unsweetened almond milk.
Add the wet ingredients to the skillet and stir to combine.
Pour the mixture into a greased 9x13-inch baking dish.
Bake for 25-30 minutes or until the top is lightly golden brown.
Remove from the oven and let cool for a few minutes before serving.
